basic_info.description: A rare opportunity to own a top-floor view condo in North Beach's coveted Malt House, a landmark building that blends historic charm with modern comfort. This 2BD/2BA residence enjoys sweeping south-facing views & a thoughtfully designed layout, flooded with natural light through oversized windows. The open-concept kitchen seamlessly connects to the dining & living areas, creating an ideal space for entertaining. Both bedrooms are generously sized. The primary suite stands out with dual closets, including a walk-in, a spacious en-suite bathroom, & its own top floor private terrace, 1 of only 2 in the building, offering picture perfect views of Coit Tower, Transamerica Building, Saints Peter & Paul Church, & Russian Hill. Additional highlights include in-unit washer/dryer, a full guest bathroom, assigned parking, & storage.  The Historic Malt House was converted into a luxury 88 unit complex, uniquely featuring an internal private park setting in the center of its complex, crowned by two of the factory's original grain silos & a 45-degree-angled flume carrying water to a basalt lava stone fountain.  Nearby public transit, Trader Joe's, Washington Square, Joe DiMaggio Playground, North Beach Library & Pool, the waterfront, & iconic dining along Columbus Avenue.
